sources.title: East African Community: Visa-Free Entry
sources.officialityEvidence: The live eac.int page is published by the East African Community Secretariat and links Article 7(1) of the EAC Common Market Protocol.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Partner States are implementing Article 7(1) ... provision for visa-free entry of citizens of EAC Partner States.

sources.title: Suspension of Visa Issuance to Foreign Nationals to Protect the Security of the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: The live travel.state.gov notice is published by the U.S. Department of State and implements Presidential Proclamation 10998.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The Department of State fully suspended visa issuance to nationals of 19 countries ... South Sudan.

conflicts.explanation: The current full suspension and its dual-national, LPR, diplomatic/official, SIV, sporting-event and case-by-case exceptions cannot be faithfully flattened to a normal visitor status.
